name: CircleCI
subtitle: Hosted CI/CD service
creator: Paul Biggar and Allen Rohner
description: A cloud CI/CD service configured with .circleci/config.yml, known for fast Docker-first builds, parallelism with test splitting, and reusable orbs. It works with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket.
useCases: Advanced CI independent of your git host

concepts.explanation: What runs and in what order.
Speed up and share data between jobs.
Billing unit that varies by machine size.

codeSamples.label: YAML · .circleci/config.yml
codeSamples.code:
version: 2.1
jobs:
  test:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/node:24.0
    steps:
      - checkout
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
workflows:
  ci:
    jobs:
      - test

cons: A 2023 security incident required rotating all secrets
Credit pricing is harder to reason about

pricing.summary: Free: 30,000 credits/mo (about 6,000 small Docker build minutes), up to 5 users. Performance: from $15/mo with 30,000 credits, then $15 per 25,000 credits.
